summary: Verified CSS z-index fix for mobile reserve bar overlapping the menu drawer on stay detail pages. Mobile viewport (390x844) on /stays/home/living-studio: .sx-mbar (z-index:600) is fully covered by .menu-drawer (z-index:900) when the hamburger menu is open. elementFromPoint at the reserve-bar center returns 'DIV.menu-drawer menu-drawer--open' confirming the drawer paints on top. Site header while menu open has z-index:910 (as applied). Menu close returns reserve bar to visible. Desktop (1920x800) homepage menu opens full-screen without visual breakage. Mobile homepage menu open/close works. /stays/search on mobile renders list-only (0 map containers) with filter chips (7 chip/filter elements) intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: 401 errors seen on 4 resource loads across pages (likely user/session or image endpoint); not related to this fix but worth main agent investigation.

Playwright is_visible() reports .menu-drawer still 'visible' after close click because element remains in DOM via CSS transition (opacity/transform). Not a bug — functional close verified visually (subsequent navigation and screenshots render correctly). Consider toggling an aria-hidden attribute or display:none post-transition for better a11y/testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: z-index stacking fix verified. .sx-mbar=600, .menu-drawer=900, .site-header--menu-open=910. If future changes touch App.css z-index tokens, re-run the mobile stay detail menu-open check and confirm elementFromPoint over the bottom reserve bar returns the drawer, not .sx-mbar.
rca of the issue: On mobile stay detail pages, .sx-mbar fixed reserve bar had z-index:600 while the menu-drawer only had z-index:30, so the drawer rendered beneath the reserve bar even when open. Fix raises .menu-drawer to 900 and .site-header--menu-open to 910 (above sx-mbar=600), restoring the full-screen menu takeover. Verified on 390x844 viewport.
